create.name: Agapi Stassinopoulos
create.bio:
Agapi Stassinopoulos is a Greek-born author and speaker who writes and teaches about prayer, meditation and a joyful, spirit-led life. She grew up in Athens, trained as an actor at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art in London, and later earned a master's degree in psychology at the University of Santa Monica. Her early books explored the gods and goddesses of Greek myth as archetypes for modern life, and two of those titles, Conversations with the Goddesses and Gods and Goddesses in Love, became PBS specials.

Her later books are more personal and practical. Unbinding the Heart draws on her Greek upbringing and life experiences to talk about generosity and unconditional love. Wake Up to the Joy of You offers a year of weekly meditations and practices for letting go of what no longer serves and building a calmer, happier life. Speaking with Spirit gathers 52 prayers and stories for a daily conversation with something larger than ourselves. She leads workshops for Thrive Global, the company founded by her sister Arianna Huffington, and has led talks and guided meditations at many companies and cultural organisations. She shares free guided meditations, videos and poems through her website and lives partly in New York and partly in Los Angeles.
